original: Vale of Clara is a national nature reserve of approximately 545 acres located in County Wicklow, Ireland. It is managed by the Irish National Parks & Wildlife Service, part of the Department of Housing, Local Government and Heritage.
translated: Vale of Clara ist ein nationales Naturschutzgebiet von etwa 545 Hektar in der Grafschaft Wicklow, Irland. Es wird vom Irish National Parks & Wildlife Service verwaltet, der Teil des Department of Housing, Local Government and Heritage ist.
